_readme.title: Ameen Hub AI Insurance Agent — n8n Workflow
_readme.description: This workflow powers the AI Call Center widget on the Ameen Hub insurance website. It receives user messages from Odoo, enriches them with live insurance DB context, calls OpenAI GPT-4o, and returns a formatted reply with quick-reply buttons.
setup_steps: 1. Import this JSON into n8n: Menu → Workflows → Import from File
2. Add your OpenAI API key: Credentials → New → OpenAI API
3. Activate the workflow and copy the Webhook Production URL
4. In Odoo: Settings → Technical → Parameters → System Parameters
6. The Odoo AI chat endpoint /insurance/ai-chat will now route through this workflow

context.categories: Array of {id, name} insurance categories from Odoo DB
context.relevant_types: Array of {id, name} matched insurance types (keyword-based)
context.stats: Object with total_products, total_policies, total_clients counts

expected_output.quick_replies: Array of up to 4 suggested follow-up button labels
